WITH timing_averages AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(eventannotm, 'Missing') AS timing,
    AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(eventannotm, 'Missing')
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  AVG(t.avg_ownership) AS mean_of_above_average_timings,
  AVG(t.avg_ownership - o.avg_ownership) AS average_amount_above_overall
FROM timing_averages t
CROSS JOIN overall_average o
WHERE t.avg_ownership > o.avg_ownership;
